notes: Walk out of a group chat into a private one and they remember what just happened. Every conversation could previously only see its own thread, so someone who had been standing in a group discussion five minutes earlier met you privately with no idea it had taken place. Characters now carry the recent run of any group they belong to into their one-to-one chat, with everyone's names on the lines and how long ago it was, so you can pick something up privately without explaining it first. It does not work the other way: what you say in a private chat stays there and never reaches a room full of other characters, because a secret repeated in front of everyone is a worse failure than a forgotten one.
